projects.name: HAR: Real-Time Human Activity Recognition Engine
projects.description: An intelligent web application utilizing the browser's DeviceMotion API and a sliding-window data structure to process multi-axis smartphone sensor telemetry (accelerometer & gyroscope) in real-time at 20Hz.
points: Engineered a web application utilizing the browser's DeviceMotion API and a sliding-window data structure to process multi-axis smartphone sensor telemetry (accelerometer and gyroscope) in real-time at 20Hz.
